mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it brought the nerve and blood routes together and showed that muscles need both signals and supplies.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the digestive tract and urinary organs into named slots was clear, but felt more like straightforward placement than a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: The joined chest and lower body showed how the diaphragm separates them while nerves, vessels and the food pipe still cross between regions.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though some placements mostly followed named slots rather than asking me to figure out a connection.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it explored a new connection; this final assembly was satisfying, but several placements were predictable.
